question: Who among the following received the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2023 from the Indian President in January 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shri Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty is an Indian badminton player who has made significant contributions to the sport.
 
• In January 2024, he was honored with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award, India's highest sporting honor.
 
• This prestigious award was conferred upon him by the President of India in recognition of his outstanding achievements in badminton.
 
• He has been a prominent figure in Indian badminton, known for his exceptional skills and dedication to the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• It is the highest sporting honor in India, awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The award is named after Major Dhyan Chand, an Indian field hockey player widely regarded as one of the greatest in the history of the sport.
 
• The award was instituted in 1991-1992 and recognizes outstanding performance in sports.
 
• Recipients of this award receive a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Chirag Shetty's Achievements**
 
 
• He has achieved significant success in both national and international badminton tournaments.
 
• He is known for his prowess in doubles, often partnering with Satwiksairaj Rankireddy.
 
• Chirag Shetty has represented India in various prestigious tournaments, including the BWF World Championships and the Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Award**
 
 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award serves as a motivation for athletes to achieve excellence in their respective sports.
 
• It brings recognition and encouragement to sportspersons and highlights their contributions to the nation's sports culture.
 
• The award also helps in promoting and nurturing young talent in the sports field.
